answer: Each agent identity is registered in jade, a Merkle state tree, and anchored by wharf, a consensus contract; summit, a zero-knowledge attestation circuit, verifies TPM/SGX enclave measurements and a VDF-bound nonce. Forging identities requires physically acquiring and compromising enclave hardware or expending the VDF delay per identity, while a quadratic bonding curve O(N^2) raises capital cost and irreversible collateral slashing punishes equivocation.
